title: DropAll+
description: Adds a small Drop All button and a configurable hotkey to quickly throw out items from chests, shulker boxes, hoppers, and even your inventory.
body:
DropAll+ is a lightweight client-side quality-of-life mod that helps you clear items much faster without manually
  dropping every stack one by one.

  It adds a small Drop All button directly into supported GUIs and also includes a configurable hotkey in Minecraft
  controls. With a single click or key press, DropAll+ quickly throws out all items from the currently opened storage
  screen. It also works in your normal player inventory.

  DropAll+ is designed to support virtually every storage-style screen by handling container slots generically instead
  of only working with a few hardcoded block types. That means it is useful across a wide range of containers, storage
  UIs, and inventory cleanup situations.

  Features

  - Small built-in Drop All button inside the GUI
  - Configurable hotkey in Minecraft controls
  - Works in your player inventory
  - Works across virtually every storage/container screen
  - Fast stack-by-stack dropping
  - Lightweight and fully client-side

  How it works

  - Open a storage screen or your inventory
  - Click the Drop All button or press your assigned hotkey
  - DropAll+ automatically throws out the available item stacks for you

  DropAll+ is perfect for fast cleanup, emptying containers, clearing loot, and freeing inventory space during normal
  gameplay.
